Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund

events.name: Six Degrees of Santa
events.description: Christmas enthusiast and single mother Harper creates a program dubbed Six Degrees of Santa in which anonymous 'Santas' give a gift to be passed along, temporarily enjoyed, and re-gifted indefinitely. Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund

events.name: Six Degrees of Santa
events.description: Christmas enthusiast and single mother Harper creates a program dubbed Six Degrees of Santa in which anonymous 'Santas' give a gift to be passed along, temporarily enjoyed, and re-gifted indefinitely. Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

events.name: Case Sensitive
events.description: Part one of two. New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

events.description: Documentary following the lives of locals living along Yorkshire's coastline. This episode features members of the Robson family from Bridlington, who've been fishing the North Sea for generations, as they head up the coast to Whitby for a boat repair. Volunteers at Bempton Cliffs work to protect and preserve almost half a million seabirds, and a group of sea swimmers take a full-moon sea swim at Scarborough

Period drama, based on the novel by EM Forster, starring Helena Bonham Carter, Judy Davis and Rupert Graves.

events.description: Conspiracy thriller starring Michael Douglas and Kiefer Sutherland. events.name: Back to Love
events.description: Erica returns to her hometown for the first time since her solder husband was killed in action. Arriving in time to attend her sister's wedding, Erica has mixed emotions about being back, a feeling only made worse when she realises she has lingering affections for her old friend Nate. Now, amid the chaos of an off-again-on-again wedding, the returning widow must decide whether the time is right to move on from her late spouse and give love another chance. Romantic drama, starring Courtney Ford

events.name: The Sundowners

His wife and teenage son, however, are weary of the nomadic way of life and try to persuade him to settle down so they can get a mortgage on a farm. Adventure set in 1920s Australia, starring Robert Mitchum, Deborah Kerr, Peter Ustinov and Ronald Fraser
